A '''kilassin claw necklace''' was a type of [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]] made from the [[Claw/Legends|claws]] of the [[kilassin]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of giant [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The wearers of kilassin claw necklaces were held with high esteem by members of the [[Tarasin]] people.<ref name="Hunting The Wyrd" /> Around [[29 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the initial setting of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign is one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the Living Force adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the Living Force adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by the time of that adventure over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Hunting the Wyrd]]'', can therefore be dated to around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Dariana]], the matriarch of the Tarasin [[Hiironi irstat]] [[Irstat|tribe]], gave kilassin claw necklaces to each member of a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] that had supported a joint operation by the [[Cularin Militia]] and an alliance of Tarasin tribes to challenge the [[Wyrd]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]]. Dariana intended the gift to to recognize the determination and bravery demonstrated by the agents during the course of the anti-Wyrd operation, in which the operatives had played a key role in bringing about the witches' defeat.<ref name="Hunting The Wyrd" />
